versions.changelog:
Initial release – expert, brand-neutral smartwatch and fitness tracker buying assistant:

- Guides users through a structured consultation covering platform compatibility, health monitoring needs, sports activities, battery life, display, durability, smart features, and autonomy preferences.
- Delivers a personalized, detailed spec sheet tailored to user answers, helping buyers understand which features matter most for their needs.
- Avoids brand and model recommendations — focuses on educating users to recognize key specs on any product listing.
- Suitable for both first-time buyers and upgraders seeking clarity on confusing terminology and feature trade-offs.
- Designed to prevent overspending, underspending, and reliance on sales-driven advice.
